title: K08 style-conditioned editing-trajectory hypotheses, frozen before acceptance tests
ranking_criterion: N02 uses an indefinite good-watch maxim and next pair of hands; N06 uses lamp stays on and corridor quiet. N13 supplies mugs and lamp, N20 sea/end-of-night/voices/table. Rank by plausibility of an understated single-sentence edit of first and second Emily drafts, with those late motifs; final entries become more proverbial and therefore weaker. Sentence punctuation is irrelevant under normalization.

phrases.caption: The little lamp stays on, and there is always room for one more cup before the sea turns light.
The sea keeps the last hour of the night, and we keep a place at the table.
A good watch leaves a light on and a place at the table for whoever comes next.
By the time the sea is light, there is still one more mug at the table.
The sea is outside, the night is almost finished, and the little lamp is still on.
There is always room at the table for one more voice before the sea wakes up.
The end of a good watch is a light left on for the next pair of hands.
The mugs stay by the window until the last voice at the table has gone quiet.
After a long watch, the sea is outside and there is still room for another chair.
At the end of the night, the table has room for the ones who came in last.
The little lamp stays on while the sea and the night give way to another morning.
A place at the table is worth more than knowing when the night watch ends.
